SUN_S1E02_P01.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E02_P01.text: I'm sorry. I'm not your general.

SUN_S1E02_P01.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E02_P01.text: Then I imagine you should be angry with him.

SUN_S1E02_P01.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E02_P01.text: Could we have some water before this becomes a meeting?

SUN_S1E02_P01.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E02_P01.text: That's what I was afraid of.

SUN_S1E02_P02.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E02_P02.text: No, sir. I mean I can't. I don't know any of you.

SUN_S1E02_P02.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E02_P02.text: I know. They seem to find that suspicious.

SUN_S1E02_P02.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E02_P02.text: Does this bother you at all?

SUN_S1E02_P02.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E02_P02.text: The gun on the table bothers me. The rest is mostly inconvenient.

SUN_S1E02_P03.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E02_P03.text: How long has he been calling himself Kael?

SUN_S1E02_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E02_P03.text: Yes. Usually I wait for a reason before I accuse them of it.

SUN_S1E02_P03.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E02_P03.text: I've got four names attached to that face.

SUN_S1E02_P03.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E02_P03.text: Ask him where he was three years ago.

SUN_S1E02_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E02_P03.text: No. He answers the question you actually ask. That's why you don't like it.

SUN_S1E02_P03.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E02_P03.text: I trust him more than I trust you.

SUN_S1E02_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E02_P04.text: I stopped him from shooting somebody.

SUN_S1E02_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E02_P04.text: I don't care what Saye always did.

SUN_S1E02_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E02_P04.text: Yes, I'm beginning to understand that.

SUN_S1E02_P04.speaker: Sand Rider
SUN_S1E02_P04.text: Then you'll keep having this problem.

SUN_S1E02_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E02_P04.text: Do you have a useful suggestion?

SUN_S1E02_P04.speaker: Sand Rider
SUN_S1E02_P04.text: Leave before they ask you to bless a marriage.

SUN_S1E02_P05.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E02_P05.text: I'm not your general. If I leave and you still can't decide, what have I actually settled?

SUN_S1E02_P05.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E02_P05.text: I don't know. Was he any good at this?

SUN_S1E02_P05.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E02_P05.text: Then ask the people who knew him on the good days.

SUN_S1E02_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E02_P06.text: A preacher told them to expect Saye.

SUN_S1E02_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E02_P06.text: And he said Saye would deny knowing them.

SUN_S1E02_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E02_P06.text: All right. That part I don't like.

SUN_S1E02_P06.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E02_P06.text: It still doesn't mean he knows me.

SUN_S1E02_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E02_P06.text: I don't know him well enough.

SUN_S1E02_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E02_P06.text: You packed his bag before he agreed to leave.

SUN_S1E02_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E02_P06.text: You keep saying things that aren't answers.

SUN_S1E02_P06.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E02_P06.text: More than what strangers say he is.

SUN_S1E02_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E02_P06.text: That has not stopped us yet.
